name: I Know a Guy
summary: Friz sends you to Booty Bay to meet his contact, Ruzzgot. The contact gets goods from the local freebooters and will explain what comes next.

sections.title: A Contact in Booty Bay
sections.body: Friz says his contact is Ruzzgot, waiting in Booty Bay. He gets goods from the pirates there, whom Friz calls freebooters. Find Ruzzgot, and he will explain the rest.

faq.answer: Friz names Ruzzgot as his contact in Booty Bay.
Friz sends you to Booty Bay to meet Ruzzgot.
Ruzzgot gets goods from the local pirates in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does Friz call the pirates freebooters?
faq.answer: Friz says some people call pirates freebooters, and jokes that the word contains “free booty.”
